 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Scott Malpass. Scott was the CIO of Notre Dame's endowment for 32 years, and has always been a pioneer at the forefront of the endowment investing world. Leading Notre Dame's early investments into Sequoia, as well as some of the premier fund managers in China decades ago. Scott built the endowment into a powerhouse, scaling it from 400 million to over 12 billion of assets under management, across 175 managers. In our conversation, we talked about the qualities he looks for in great investors, how asset classes have evolved over his 30 years of investing and how Scott recruited top talent to work at Notre Dame's endowment. Scott is clearly on the Mount Rushmore of institutional investors, and I'm lucky to consider him a mentor and a friend. I hope you enjoy this great conversation with Scott Malpass.

 Becoming Notre Dame's CIO
